objective: Prove: on every pattern of three-place knots with no cycle of knots (Berge-acyclic) not-all-equal reads faithfully and bond distance is steps apart plus one at every distance; every pattern whose knots each lie within four consecutive distinctions of an order allows a state, while reach five allows a contradiction, so growth that touches only its newest distinctions never ends at reach four and ends almost surely at reach five or more when closings occur; record what holds by definition at the last base.
title: What the law reads where knots form no cycle, and when growth cannot end
